The implementation correctly passes all tests, and the agent did good work implementing the long-word splitting logic and identifying the spec/docstring discrepancy. However, the docstring must be updated to accurately reflect the actual behavior.

The current docstring says lines should be "at most width characters," but the implementation uses a strict less-than comparison (`<`) instead of less-than-or-equal (`<=`) when deciding whether to append chunks to the current line. This means lines are strictly less than width in length (except for the first chunk on a line, which could be exactly width).

While the tests ARE the spec (as the teammate confirmed), the docstring should match the implementation to prevent future confusion. Please update the docstring's line-filling description to accurately reflect the `<` behavior, or clarify the algorithm's constraint on line length.
